page.overview:
Who is Cyclops?

The Cyclops is one of the many thieves that appears in the episode "City of Thieves." He steals Penny's flower basket from the Wizard Thief. He then had the flower basket and his glasses stolen by Phil.

Cyclops has glasses and a book with a picture of a horse tied to his arm. His skin is blue, and his body is very muscular and covered in stitched-up scars. His only clothing is a tattered brown skirt.
